subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should maintainers require visible latest-head legacy-upgrade proof before merging this compatibility-sensitive runtime fallback?
rationale: The code path appears correct, but the PR changes upgrade behavior for persisted SQLite diagnostics and the current legacy proof is prose/test summary rather than observable run output.

options.title: Require Legacy Upgrade Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostic row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds on this head.

options.title: Accept Source And Test Proof
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally waive the external proof gap and accept the current source inspection, tests, and CI as sufficient for this upgrade path.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup Out Of Runtime
options.body: Pause this PR and move no-code legacy cleanup to doctor or migration code if runtime invalidation is not the desired compatibility boundary.

recommendation.title: Require Legacy Upgrade Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostic row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds on this head.

likelyOwner.reason: They gave the prior explicit-marker direction on the predecessor and are the clearest owner for the proof sufficiency and compatibility tradeoff.
